Flow Clone

Everything runs on this PC. Nothing is sent over the network.

Shortcuts

Keys: Ctrl, Win, Alt, Shift, Space, Esc, A–Z, 0–9, F1–F24. Max 3 keys, at least one modifier.

Audio
Speech model

Checking…

Whisper: a whisper.cpp ggml model, e.g. ggml-base.bin (default) or ggml-small-q5_1.bin for better accuracy. Parakeet: the sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-int8 folder (needs a build with the parakeet feature). Models are never downloaded automatically: put them in .

Transcription

"comma", "new line", "quote … unquote", "in parentheses", "um", "scratch that", "$5", "3pm" — handled on this PC with or without the AI model. Off = exactly what you said (same as cleanup level Verbatim).

After a paste the field is re-read for about 45 s. Words you fix show up under Dictionary → Suggestions; nothing is added without your OK.

AI cleanup (local LLM)

Off.

Polishes what the formatting rules leave: run-on sentences, leftover fillers, corrections, tone per app. Runs llama.cpp on this PC ( next to the app). Off: the formatting rules still run. Skipped when the text is already clean; if the model is slow or changes too much, the formatted transcript is pasted instead. Loading takes a little longer than before (the instructions are prepared at load).

Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M is the fast default; Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is more accurate and about twice as slow. Never downloaded automatically.

Writing style

Which style applies depends on the app you dictate into. Chats default to casual, email and everything else to formal.

An exe name (slack.exe) or a web host (mail.example.com); overrides the built-in list.

      Engines

      Where speech is turned into text. Client = this PC. Server = your own flow-server (LAN or Tailscale); audio goes only there, never to a third party.

      Try in this order (the next one is the fallback):

          Speech decoding

          Transcribes each finished phrase while you keep talking, so a long dictation is ready about as fast as a short one (cuts go in pauses of 0.8 s or more). Off = the whole recording is transcribed after you stop. Cloud providers always get the whole recording at the end.

          Parakeet only (whisper ignores it). Changing it reloads the model.

          Server

          Stored encrypted for your Windows account (DPAPI); never logged.

          Cloud providers (sends audio to a third party)

            Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager (flow-clone/cloud/<id>), never in prefs.json, and never logged.
